issues.reason: Thematic roles reserves Patient for an object the action creates, destroys, consumes or physically changes; threads left on the lantern are deposited unchanged (the transferred/moved case), and the rule's own tie-breaker "when the test is unclear, default to Theme" points the same way, so (Patient sk_leave_1 sk_group_2) asserts a change the sentence does not state.

Term propagation copies the antecedent event's stated day-level terms and explicitly falls back to "If the antecedent's day is unknown, emit just the day-part" — the night this "that night" points at is the sundown lighting, which carries no Day/Year term (the passage attaches Day 80 / Year 1 to the approval clause alone), so importing them onto sk_tend_1 would assert a date the text never gives the tending.

gaps_confirmed: "for the first time" — an nth-occasion adverbial over occurrences of the event has no licensed carrier (Ordinal ranks an entity on a scale, not occasions of an event), so the qualifier is silently dropped
new_gaps: A passage-initial date frame ("On day 80 of Year 1, the Council approved …") has no propagation mechanism to later clauses: the instruction set attaches calendar terms clause by clause, so every undated event in the passage — and the anaphoric "that night" — loses the day anchor the narrative supplies

An in-world calendar ("day 80 of Year 1"): the structured (Day n) / (Year n) terms presume Gregorian day-of-month and calendar year, so a day-of-year count and a bare regnal year have no specified term and the seeded date-ordering rules would read them wrongly

Coordinated time adjuncts on one clause ("at midnight and at the third watch") — nothing states whether to replicate the whole event once per adjunct (as here) or stack two Time atoms on a single event; the Coordination section covers clauses, VPs and NPs only
defect_summary: Statement 69 should be (Theme sk_leave_1 sk_group_2) — leaving threads on the lantern moves them without altering them, so the object-change test (and its default-to-Theme fallback) gives Theme; the rest of the leave bundle, including the Location oblique and the silken_thread group, stands as parsed.
notes: Everything else checks out against the instruction set: the postural "stood beside" correctly mints no event and takes the entity-attached (Past (Beside …)), the wick gets no invented PartOf to the lantern, and "after sundown" as (TimeAtLeast sk_land_1 sundown) is the licensed day-part-constant bound. PartOf vs Possession for "the lantern of the Harbor Station" and the bare kind fillers half_shift / mist_light are genuine coin-flips the instruction set leaves open, not defects.
